name: relai
description: Eval-driven improvement for AI agents. Build evals first, then improve your agent against them: evals from your traces, code and risks for agent applications, and from sessions, pull requests and git history for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: RELAI turns your agent's code and traces into requirements, risks and evaluations, then measures changes against the behavior, cost or latency goal you agree. Seven skills: start, discover, trace-review (a trace review app you own, with saved feedback), eval, improve, loop, and coding-evals (evaluations for the coding agent your team uses, built from its sessions, pull requests and git history). Runs on Harbor or your own runner. Needs Python 3.11+; running evals needs a container engine or your own runner, and model access.
defaultPrompt: Use RELAI's start skill to see where this agent stands and what to do next.
Use RELAI's loop skill to improve this agent from its traces.
Use RELAI's coding-evals skill to turn a pull request or coding session into a reusable coding-agent evaluation.
